Apparently getting a job now means answering questions like:
“Have you ever been in an accident that resulted in your death?”

Yeah… real application question.

In this video, we go through some of the most ridiculous things companies are asking people during the hiring process — trick questions, personality bait, social media requests, endless interviews, coding tests, video introductions, and somehow your high school grades from 15 years ago.
